name: - Defrost
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to flashLoan, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short multi-step attack that chains a DEX flash swap with an ERC3156 flash loan and abuses protocol-specific deposit/redeem accounting in the same transaction. It is not deeply complex, but it does require understanding the victim vault logic and coordinating callbacks across multiple contracts, which is more than a trivial single-pattern bug.
